name: ai-usage-04
description: The share of input tokens served from the cache, what it saved and what the tokens would have cost without it.

files.content:
'use client' import { type TokenCounts, type TokenPrices, TokenSplitBar, formatTokens, formatUsd, getCacheHitRate, getCacheSavings, getTokenCost, tokenPartColors, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/ai-usage' import { BlockReady, BlockStateProvider, type BlockStatus, getBlockState, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { KPI, KPIChange, KPITitle, KPIValue, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/kpi' interface AiUsage4Props { /** Follows the previous hit rate in the sentence. @default 'last month' */ comparison?: string description: string /** Hit rate for the period before, 0–1, to show the change. */ previousHitRate?: number prices: TokenPrices status?: BlockStatus title: string /** Leave out to show the empty state. */ tokens?: TokenCounts } const exampleProps: AiUsage4Props = { description: 'All requests this month. Cached input costs a tenth of the input price.', previousHitRate: 0.24, prices: { cached: 0.3, input: 3, output: 15 }, title: 'Prompt caching', tokens: { cached: 83_000_000, input: 197_000_000, output: 25_500_000 }, } const tokenParts = [ { key: 'input', label: 'Input' }, { key: 'cached', label: 'Cached' }, { key: 'output', label: 'Output' }, ] as const const AiUsage4 = (props: AiUsage4Props) => { const { comparison = 'last month', description, previousHitRate, prices, status, title, tokens = { input: 0, output: 0 }, } = props const state = getBlockState(status, props.tokens === undefined) const hitRate = getCacheHitRate(tokens) const saved = getCacheSavings(tokens.cached ?? 0, prices) const cost = getTokenCost(tokens, prices) const asPercent = (rate: number) => Math.round(rate * 1_000) / 10 return (

{title}

{description}

Input tokens served from the cache {previousHitRate !== undefined && ( )} {state !== 'empty' && state !== 'error' && ( <>
Saved by caching
Spent on tokens
{formatUsd(cost + saved)} without the cache
    {tokenParts.map((part) => (
  • {part.label} {formatTokens(tokens[part.key] ?? 0)}
    • ))}
)}
) } export { AiUsage4, exampleProps as aiUsage4ExampleProps, type AiUsage4Props }
